comment: Interrogative pronouns that ask for one plain event-role predicate (CONTRACT.md section 4, event-subject rows only: actor/object/origin/destination/time/place). Used only when no source/occurrence/verification cue matched (cues.json), so a specific question never falls through to the generic role question. 'anchor_priority' lists which other grammatical function (markers.json) may identify the event, in preference order, excluding the function that would just restate the asked predicate.
